title: Outbound call record
description: The platform's record of one outbound call an outside part made or tried to make, with its destination, the module version and the transaction (REQ-MDL-8). The platform's egress layer writes it, not the module, since the outside part is the provider's own code (THR-83). Each connection is a hop: the first, then one per redirect, each with the name asked for and the address connected to, so the record shows ADR-0004's checks were made at every hop. A refused call is recorded too.

transaction.description: The transaction the call was made for (REQ-MDL-8, REQ-MDL-10).

provider.description: The provider whose outside part made the call.

module_version.description: The version of the module that made it (REQ-MDL-8).

operation.description: The outside operation the call was made under.

secrets.description: The names of the secrets resolved for the call, so each use is attributable to the transaction (REQ-MDL-6). Names only, never values. Empty if none.

hops.description: The connections in order: the first, then one per redirect. At least one.

hop.description: One connection: where it was asked to go, the declared destination that matched by name, and the address actually connected to. A hop refused before connecting has no address, and one whose name matched no declared destination has no destination; either is the last hop of a refused call. The last hop of an unknown call may also have no address, when it matched a declared destination and its dial connected to nothing.

destination.description: The name of the declared destination the hop matched.

outcome.description: By status: completed or failed, as the destination answered; unknown, when no answer came, the request perhaps sent or, with no address on the last hop, nothing connected; or refused by the platform, with the reason.
